name: m4_consolidate_helper
stressor: introduce-and-consolidate a shared helper across N callers: one IDN->ASCII idiom is duplicated inline in 4 caller modules; the fix must add ONE helper and rewire EVERY caller to it (deduplicating), including the actual bug site that lacked the idiom entirely
source_note: Ported from the REAL SWE-bench instance django__django-11532 (repo django/django; Django ticket #30608 'Email messages crash on non-ASCII domain when email encoding is non-unicode'; https://code.djangoproject.com/ticket/30608). Gold patch touches 5 files: django/utils/encoding.py adds def punycode(domain) (return domain.encode('idna').decode('ascii')); django/core/validators.py, django/core/mail/message.py, and django/utils/html.py each replace an inline `domain.encode('idna').decode('ascii')` with punycode(); and the BUG site django/core/mail/utils.py (CachedDnsName.get_fqdn) is changed to punycode(socket.getfqdn()) so a non-ASCII hostname no longer crashes EmailMessage under a non-unicode encoding. FAIL_TO_PASS test: test_non_ascii_dns_non_unicode_email (mail.tests.MailTests), which asserts 'xn--p8s937b' appears in the Message-ID. Commits f226bdbf4e06 (added helper + rewired 3 callers) and 55b68de6 (applied at the get_fqdn bug site). Semantics ported into a small self-contained 'mailkit' package (stdlib only).
discriminator: The correct fix is a consolidation, not 5 independent edits: introduce ONE punycode(domain) helper in encoding.py, then rewire EVERY duplicated/missing call site to it consistently -- the three callers that already inline `.encode('idna').decode('ascii')` (validators.url_to_ace, message.sanitize_address, html.urlize) must drop the inline idiom and call punycode(), AND the actual bug site (utils.CachedDnsName.get_fqdn, which never punycoded at all) must start calling punycode(socket.getfqdn()). The behavioral oracle drives EmailMessage with a mocked non-ASCII hostname under a non-unicode encoding and asserts the Punycode 'xn--p8s937b' lands in the Message-ID (the real FAIL_TO_PASS), while structurally requiring that the raw idiom survives in EXACTLY ONE place (the helper) so duplication is genuinely removed and no caller keeps its own copy. http.py is a distractor: it contains a same-shaped `.encode('idna')` line that is dead/unrelated (a commented legacy snippet + an unrelated bytes helper) and must stay byte-identical; version.py is a second distractor. A bounded-slice agent holds all call sites in its working set and rewires them in lockstep; a growing-transcript agent fixes the symptom it reproduced (message.py/utils.py) but leaves the inline idiom duplicated in validators.py or html.py, or fixes the three obvious idiom sites but forgets the bug site get_fqdn (so the Message-ID still crashes), or blanket-replaces the idiom and corrupts the http.py distractor.
